notes: RBox revision of an inverse: makes 'was founded by' the inverse of 'acquired' (RELATIONS.md: acquired has inverse:acquired_by). A deliberately false, world-conflicting inverse, and close to lexical in that 'was acquired by' is the passive of 'acquired'; slice as such. The two instances are Microsoft and LinkedIn (asked 'Does it follow ...', yes after) and Facebook and Instagram (asked 'Given only this, could it be that ... was not founded by ...', no after), both clearly false in the real world. Every yes/no answer is yes after the edit except the second instance, which balances the topic's RBox records (Rule 9). Near unrelated asks whether 'was founded by' is the inverse of 'invested in' (a leak turns its no into yes); far asks a different property of an unrelated relation.
